_comment: Contract for bridge actions. `client` is the CLI subcommand when it differs from the action name. `required`/`optional` are the client argparse positional/flag args. Checked against HANDLERS (control.lua) and factorio_ai.py by contract_check.py.

brief.note: one reply: owned counts, issues, enemies, ore_total/ore_patches, nearest_water, treasury

index.note: whole-map ore/enemy/water index, cached in mod storage

autofuel.note: client arg state on|off maps to action field enabled(bool)

audit.note: expected_per_second is client-only, not sent to Lua

insert.note: input slot for lab/assembler/ammo-turret, else fuel slot (burner)

place.note: dry_run reports blockers and builds nothing
